name: 🔥🗞The Informant
text:
✈️🇪🇺 Four passenger flights were diverted or searched across Europe after bomb threats on Tuesday, and no explosives have been found. Authorities in Poland said one threat was not confirmed.

El Al flight 551 from Israel landed in Sofia after a bomb threat received by email, and counter-terrorism units searched it, Bulgaria's interior ministry told BTA. A LOT flight from London Heathrow to Warsaw was diverted to Warsaw-Modlin airport, which briefly closed and has resumed normal service. An SAS flight from Copenhagen landed at Warsaw-Chopin, where Polish authorities said the threat was not confirmed. A Ryanair flight from Manchester landed at Murcia, Spain, at 9:50 a.m. UK time. On Monday, a Wizz Air flight from London to Sofia was diverted to Budapest after a bomb threat.

An Israeli outlet reported that authorities suspect a coordinated hoax and that the LOT flight carried Jewish students; I found no official confirmation of either. Separately, Lisbon airport's Terminal 1 was not evacuated: operator ANA said a ground-handling error on a flight from Brazil forced extra security screening.

Sources: BTA, LBC, JFeed, ANA via DN
